name: Action beside its result
art: The original preview object is site/assets/expansion/interactive/metal-aperture.png. Retain its modeled metallic finish rather than replacing it with skeleton bars.

properties.label: Action and result split
properties.text: Use a dark split onboarding surface with a concise project-name and tone form beside a large persistent live preview. Controls and output form one continuous story rather than unrelated cards.

properties.label: Complete miniature preview
properties.text: Render an actual miniature brand header, typographic hero, detailed metal aperture image and footer. Use composed editorial hierarchy and a small original visual rather than skeleton bars alone.

properties.label: Graphite with a brighter result
properties.text: Use near-black and graphite planes with subtle divider lines, quiet metadata and a clearly brighter preview surface.

properties.label: Clean quiet sans
properties.text: Use clean sans typography with restrained metadata and a real editorial type hierarchy inside the preview.

properties.label: Live direction consequence
properties.text: Editing the project name and selecting Quiet, Warm or Bold updates the actual preview, type treatment, palette and explanatory text. The submit action confirms the current direction; inputs remain stable and keyboard operation does not trigger page navigation.

properties.label: Visible result check
properties.text: The selected direction must visibly change the result. Review initial, intermediate and completed states at desktop and phone sizes.
